displayName: Untax Property Assessment & Tax Appeal Research
description: Source-backed property assessment research and draft assessment comparisons. Private veteran review PDFs use explicitly selected saved reviews and show unanswered questions. Retained county facts, owner reports and optional permitted VA observations remain distinct. Building-model, identity, tax-year, taxable-basis and filing holds remain in force. Drafts do not complete official forms, establish eligibility or authorize filing. Built by Moosh Works (https://mooshworks.com).
